messages:
elena: Hey runtime — marketing needs a tiny, citable bench bundle for the launch post + webinar. Minimal deliverable: CSV (raw per-request rows), one PNG heatmap (coldstart vs steady), and a 2-line caveat note. Please include env.txt with exact commit, CUDA/driver, and kernel selection.

matt: Clarify matrix: model + batch/concurrency/seqlen? Also we need the billing math inputs to compute $/1k tokens.

elena: Model = redwood/3b-compat-v1 (prod config). Matrix: batch=1,8; conc=1,16; seqlens=32/192/1024. Percentiles: 50/95/99 per-request. Include token counts and billing units used. Normalize charts to hosted fp16 baseline too.

sophie: Marketing will use one simple slide: heatmap (coldstart x seqlen) + small 2-col bar (throughput vs $/1k). If quantized int8 shows non-determinism at long context, call it out with stderr snippet. :pray:

andy: Plan: 2 warmup iterations, then 120 samples per cell. Capture 50/95/99, tokens/sec, GPU util, and any kernel warnings. Well package CSV + PNG + env.txt + README with reproduce block. Targeting a smoke run tomorrow AM.

elena: Sample prompts: https://gist.example.com/redwood/webinar-samples (use the "webinar-clean" set).

matt: Repro snippet we'll include in README:
```
# reproduce-smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.internal.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNTIME_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/3b-compat-v1","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":64,"batch":1}'
```

bench-bot: Run scheduled: run_id=launch-evidence-175880-01. Logs: /internal/bench/runs/launch-evidence-175880-01. ETA ~3h.

andy: If any cell fails (esp. int8 @1024), we'll mark it unstable and provide a conservative phrasing for copy. Sophie: deadline for marketing assets?

sophie: Need the artifact bundle (CSV + PNG + 2-line caveat + normalized chart) by Fri 17:00 PT. If thats a problem, call it out now so we adjust the slide.

elena: Thanks — please ping @matt and @andy for status updates. Keep visuals minimal and reproducible.
